purpose: Raise a possibility without claiming certainty.
keywords: もしかしたら + かもしれない / speculative predicate
Perhaps tomorrow is a day off.
Maybe this is the right key.
Perhaps we took the wrong road.
formation: もしかしたら + かもしれない / speculative predicate
restrictions: Often introduces a tentative guess about an uncertain situation.
mistake: もしかしたら is a possibility marker, not a condition meaning if you can.
